description: Netlife Craft CMS update policy. Sites extend this with one line.

packageRules.description: Patch updates, one PR a week, automerged when verify is green.
Minor updates, one PR a month, always merged by a developer. Labelled preview so craft-preview builds a site to look at.
schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Majors are project work, never automated.
Vulnerability fixes open immediately; patch-level fixes automerge when verify is green.
